_about: Daily targets per adult for the micronutrient card. min = ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA (or AI where no RDA is set: potassium). max = tolerable upper limit where ICMR-NIN gives one (null = none set). Entered by the developer from the published tables 'Nutrient Requirements for Indians (ICMR-NIN 2020)': PLEASE CHECK EVERY NUMBER against the PDF before release (this build had no internet access). Out of scope on purpose: pregnancy, breastfeeding, under 18, medical conditions.
_notes: Magnesium upper limit is for supplements only, so it is shown as a note, not a warning, and food-only totals above it are never flagged. For sex 'other' or not set, the lower of the two RDAs is NOT used: the card asks for sex in the profile instead of guessing.
